get_num_gpus: get the number of available GPUs using faiss.get_num_gpus()
create_index_flat_l2: create a flat L2 index with faiss.IndexFlatL2 for a given dimension
index_cpu_to_all_gpus: transfer a CPU index to all available GPUs using faiss.index_cpu_to_all_gpus
add_vectors_to_index: add vectors to a FAISS GPU index using the add method
search_nearest_neighbors: search for k nearest neighbors in a FAISS GPU index using the search method
